comments.text: If Serious illness booster doesn't take then these 9 disease cover or not in HDFC ergo optima secure plus.
comments.author: @KevalJain-b5j

comments.text:
Hi! If you do not opt for the Serious Illness Booster add-on in HDFC ERGO Optima Secure Plus, then the additional cover meant specifically for those listed 9 serious illnesses will not be available. That said, the base policy will still continue to cover hospitalisation expenses for those illnesses like a regular health insurance claim, subject to policy terms and conditions.
The Serious Illness Booster works as a separate add-on benefit with its own dedicated Sum Insured. So, if a claim is paid under this add-on, it does not reduce the base policy Sum Insured.
